name: @clorat/tarol-admin
description: An admin UI for Tarol backends: dead letters (re-drive, discard), projection versions (drop) and a data subject's export and erasure.

scripts.generate: node scripts/extract.mjs ../tarol-codegen/test/fixtures/artflow.openapi.json /tarol/admin openapi.admin.json && tarol-codegen openapi.admin.json -o src/lib/api.ts
scripts.check:package: publint --strict && node scripts/extract.mjs ../tarol-codegen/test/fixtures/artflow.openapi.json /tarol/admin openapi.admin.json --check && tarol-codegen openapi.admin.json -o src/lib/api.ts --check

size-limit.name: AdminApp (compiled, incl. CSS; without svelte and @clorat) — SV-18
